prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Extreme wide shot. The last storm clouds rolling away over a washed green valley, a pale rainbow brightening across the sky and sunlight sweeping over the wet grass. Late afternoon after rain. Vast and gentle. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No people, no text, no logos.
